# Journavx study
## Emily Wichmann
### 2026-10-21

NOTES:

This is the R markdown document for Journavx analysis.The datasets are downloaded as CVS files from SDUD website 10/19/2026.

SDUD: THE SDUD IS SEPERATED BY DIFFERENT STATES, YEAR AND QUARTER. OPEN ANY STATE 2025, AND SET UP THE FILTER AS PRODUCT CONTAINS Journavx. ONLY QUARTER 1 AND 2 ARE AVAILABLE FOR 2025 NOW. THIS WILL GIVE ALL THE DRUG USE INFORMATION FOR ALL THE STATES.

MBES: THE MBES IS SEPARTED BY DIFFERENT QUARTER WITH DIFFERENT YEAR. ONLY 2025 QUARTER 1 AND 2 ARE AVAIBLE NOW.

For SDUD, used filter product name contains JOURNAVX for year 2025 (289 obs). 

Jingye data For MBES, downloaded 2025 first (171 obs) and second quarter (171 obs). No new data was downloaded Oct 2026 as there were no updates to the data since April 2026.

 4. Sum the amount of reimbursed, number of prescriptions, reimbursed units for different quarters. Use variable Medicaid_Amount_Reimbursed instead of Total_Amount_Reimbursed.
```{r}
quarterly_summary <- sdud_filtered2 %>%
 group_by(Utilization_Type, Quarter) %>%
 summarise(
 Total_Reimbursed = round(sum(`Medicaid_Amount_Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
 Total_Prescriptions = round(sum(`Number_of_Prescriptions`, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
 Total_Units = sum(`Units_Reimbursed`, na.rm = TRUE),
 groups = "drop" 
 ) %>%
 # Calculate the "Total" row for each quarter
 group_by(Quarter) %>%
 group_modify(~ {
 total_row <- tibble(
 Utilization = "Total",
 Total_Reimbursed = sum(.x$Total_Reimbursed),
 Total_Prescriptions = sum(.x$Total_Prescriptions),
 Total_Units = sum(.x$Total_Units)
 )
 bind_rows(total_row, .x)
 }) %>%
 # Calculate Percentage Share
 mutate(
 Share_Total = (Total_Reimbursed / first(Total_Reimbursed)) * 100
 ) %>%
 select(Quarter, Utilization_Type, Utilization, Total_Reimbursed, Share_Total, Total_Prescriptions, Total_Units)
```
 5. Output the Table
```{r}
#ungroup()
write.csv(quarterly_summary, "Quarterly_Medicaid_Summary12.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
 6. Create the Styled Table
```{r}
final_table <- quarterly_summary %>%
 gt(rowname_col = "Utilization", groupname_col = "Quarter") %>%
 tab_header(
 title = "Table 1. National Medicaid utilization and reimbursement for suzetrigine (Journavx®)",
 subtitle = "during first year after FDA approval (2025)"
 ) %>%
 cols_label(
 Total_Reimbursed = "Total Reimbursed ($)a",
 Share_Total = "Share of Total Reimbursed (%)",
 Total_Prescriptions = "Number of Prescriptions",
 Total_Units = "Number of Units (tablets)"
 ) %>%
 # Formatting values
 fmt_currency(columns = Total_Reimbursed, currency = "USD") %>%
 fmt_number(columns = Share_Total, decimals = 2) %>%
 #fmt_number(columns = c(Num_Prescriptions, Num_Units), decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) %>%
 # Visual Styling
 tab_options(
 row_group.font.weight = "bold",
 table.width = pct(100)
 )
 # Display the table
 final_table
```

 16. Find the number of enrollment for different state for year 2025.Q3 and Q4 data not updated to the website as of October update

### Data Retrieved and analyzed by author Jingye
 17. Read in data
```{r, eval=FALSE}
MBES_q1 <- read.csv(file="C:\\Users\\JIY116\\OneDrive - University of Pittsburgh\\Desktop\\Journavx\\MBES_q1.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",")

MBES_q2 <- read.csv(file="C:\\Users\\JIY116\\OneDrive - University of Pittsburgh\\Desktop\\Journavx\\MBES_q2.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",")
```
 18. Combine the two quarters together
```{r, eval=FALSE}
#For 2025-Q3, assign the Total_enroll as the Total_enroll 2025-Q2
#For Q3,change the value for the Enroll_Month, change 6 to 7, 7 to 8 and 8 to 9
MBES_q3 <- MBES_q2 %>%
  mutate(Enrollment_Month = ifelse(Enrollment_Month %in% 4:6, 
                                   Enrollment_Month + 3, 
                                   Enrollment_Month))


#for Q4, also used the enrollment from Q2, change change 7 to 10, 8 to 11 and 9 to 12
MBES_q4 <- MBES_q3 %>%
  mutate(Enrollment_Month = ifelse(Enrollment_Month %in% 7:9, 
                                   Enrollment_Month + 3, 
                                   Enrollment_Month))

combined_data <- rbind(MBES_q1, MBES_q2, MBES_q3, MBES_q4)
summary(combined_data)
```

 20. Average the number of enrollment for every month. Average 12 months for 4 quarters.
```{r, eval=FALSE}
total_enroll_average <- summary_data %>%
        mutate(average_enroll = total_enroll/12)
View(total_enroll_average)
```
 21. Merge the number of prescription and the number of enrollment using the state name.
```{r, eval=FALSE}
combined_data2 <- left_join(sum_prescrip_state, total_enroll_average, by = 'State')

write.csv(combined_data2, "combined_data6.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(combined_data2, n= Inf)
```
 22. Calculate the number of prescriptions per 100k enrollees.
```{r, eval=FALSE}
combined_data_pernt <- combined_data2 %>%
  mutate(prescription_rate = (combined_data2$Total_Prescriptions / combined_data2$average_enroll) * 100000)

print(combined_data_pernt, n= Inf)
```
 23. Find the top 20 prescription rate states.
```{r, eval=FALSE}
prescription_rate_top20 <- combined_data_pernt %>%
  slice_max(order_by = prescription_rate, n=20)

prescription_rate_top20_fianl <- prescription_rate_top20 %>%
  select (- total_enroll)

prescription_rate_top20_fianl2 <- prescription_rate_top20_fianl[, c("State", "Total_Prescriptions", "average_enroll", "prescription_rate", "Total_Reimbursed")] %>%
    rename(
       "State" = State,
       "Number of Prescriptions" = Total_Prescriptions ,
       "Average number of enrollment" =  average_enroll ,
       "Number of Prescriptions per 100k enrollees" = prescription_rate,
       "Total amount of Reimbursement" = Total_Reimbursed)

print(prescription_rate_top20_fianl2)
```

write.csv(prescription_rate_top20_fianl2, "prescription_rate_top20_fianl_2_0430.csv", row.names = FALSE)
